mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above the 10-week moving average predicts a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened policy expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly UNRATE above 3.5% for two consecutive months is associated with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as labor market tightening supports inflation expectations and equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite the UNRATE trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (household spending index) of at least 2% for three months predicts a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as rising consumption signals economic resilience.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the demand signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat during the contraction period.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 4%, the 5-day S&P 500 forward return is expected to be negative due to higher real interest rate expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive during the high-rate crossing.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in PAYEMS (employment) and UNRATE (unemployment) above their respective 50th percentile for the past 3 months indicate mixed labor market signals, predicting a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > PAYEMS_50P% AND UNRATE > UNRATE_50P% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the interaction trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rising trend in GDPC1 (GDP) predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as strong aggregate demand supports equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant improvement over a 12-month baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls for two consecutive months below its 12-month average, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to weak demand absorption in the supply chain.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the supply signal.
